displayContract.byline: Assessments made by 5.6 Sol. — Rubric: Slugfester Reassessment Rubric v2.

thesis.text: The AI steelman is that libertarian idealism is strongest when sourcehood means norm-sensitive authorship within an experience-inclusive reality, without requiring crude temporal branching or scientific rejection.

novelty.explanation: This repairs the underconstrained modal account by centering authorship while preserving the transcript's inclusive idealist ambition.

premises.text: Rational agency involves constitutive standards: deliberation counts as reasoning only insofar as considerations can function for the agent as evidence, justification, and grounds for revision.

novelty.explanation: This develops the transcript's objective-standards move into a constitutive account of norm-sensitive agency.

premises.text: Causal realization alone does not destroy normativity; the sharper libertarian claim is that exhaustive determination may fail to explain an agent's authorship of norm-guided commitment.

novelty.explanation: This corrects the inference from causation to irrationality and relocates the dispute to explanatory authorship.

premises.text: Alternative possibility should be constrained by agentially relevant sameness, preserving the agent's reasons, character, capacities, and governing laws while allowing the exercise of evaluative attention to differ.

novelty.explanation: This directly repairs the unspecified accessibility relation exposed by the fixed-past objection.

premises.text: Scientific models may be fully true within their explanatory purposes while remaining nonexhaustive of first-person normativity, felt salience, value, and deliberative ownership.

novelty.explanation: This strengthens anti-exhaustion without inferring that scientific abstraction establishes anti-naturalism by itself.

premises.text: The absolute is defensible only as a constrained metaphysical hypothesis whose value depends on integrating otherwise fragmented explanatory domains, not merely on inquiry having a direction.

novelty.explanation: This repairs the unsupported transition from normative striving to the independent existence of completion.

conclusion.text: Therefore libertarian idealism remains a defensible comparative hypothesis if it explains norm-sensitive authorship and experiential integration better than its rivals, while treating modal alternatives and the absolute as constrained commitments requiring further defense.

novelty.explanation: The conclusion narrows the participant's strongest themes into a conditional comparative claim supported by the repaired premises.

newArguments.title: Attentional authorship
newArguments.text: A new defense can locate libertarian control in the agent's governance of attention rather than in an unexplained breach of physical law. Deliberation changes when an agent sustains, suppresses, or reorganizes which reasons become salient, and this organization can be assessed for fidelity to evidence and values. If no lower-level description explains why the person, as an integrated normative subject, owns that pattern of attention, sourcehood may remain explanatorily indispensable even where physical events are law-governed. This does not prove indeterminism; it identifies a specific phenomenon that a reductive account must explain.

novelty.explanation: Attentional governance as the locus of sourcehood is a genuinely new line not stated in the locked transcript moves.

newArguments.title: Integration as a test
newArguments.text: Idealist integration can be made discriminating by requiring cross-domain explanatory gains. A metaphysical proposal earns admission only if it clarifies why objective reasons can be personally motivating, why felt salience can disclose value without dictating truth, and why scientific abstractions remain reliable within limited purposes. The absolute then becomes a hypothesis evaluated by unification, constraint, and correction rather than an endpoint inferred from aspiration alone. This standard answers pragmatic pressure by exposing the proposal to comparative failure whenever a simpler naturalistic model integrates the same domains equally well.

novelty.explanation: This introduces an explicit comparative test for metaphysical integration beyond the participant's live exposition of the absolute.

thesis.text: The AI steelman is that compatibilist pragmatism explains freedom through reasons-responsive control and socially embedded accountability while admitting experiential pluralism under disciplined, revisable standards.

novelty.explanation: This repairs the gap between practical functions and genuine control while combining the con side's strongest routes.

premises.text: Deterministic pressure concerns whether the same complete past and laws permit another continuation, and broad modal variation cannot by itself answer that narrower question.

novelty.explanation: This consolidates the transcript's strongest fixed-past and modal-scope arguments.

premises.text: Freedom can consist in a control profile including sensitivity to reasons, absence of coercive bypass, stable evaluative capacities, and conduct attributable to the agent's deliberative organization.

novelty.explanation: This supplies the positive account of control missing from the initial noncausal compatibilist basis.

premises.text: Praise, blame, incentives, and prediction are justified only when they track that control profile, so practical usefulness does not by itself constitute or manufacture responsibility.

novelty.explanation: This repairs the gap between social function and the underlying capacities those practices should accurately track.

premises.text: Naturalism can treat experience, value, and first-person deliberation as genuine explanatory subjects without claiming that current physical descriptions exhaust every legitimate level of understanding.

novelty.explanation: This strengthens the experience-centered response by explicitly accepting nonexhaustive explanatory pluralism.

premises.text: Metaphysical commitments should be admitted when they generate discriminating expectations, explanatory compression, or indispensable normative clarification, and should remain revisable when they fail those tests.

novelty.explanation: This operationalizes the tentative pragmatic standard that remained underspecified in the live exchange.

conclusion.text: Therefore compatibilist pragmatism can answer determinist and naturalist pressure if its responsibility practices track genuine reasons-responsive control and its pluralism admits experience without endorsing metaphysical commitments that add no discriminating explanation.

novelty.explanation: The conclusion preserves the con route while conditioning it on repaired control and admission standards.

newArguments.title: Counterfactual guidance
newArguments.text: Compatibilist control can be tested through structured counterfactuals that do not require changing the actual past. Ask whether the agent's decision process would update under variations in available evidence, perceived reasons, coercive threats, or opportunities for reflection. These tests evaluate the internal organization of the mechanism rather than whether an identical total universe could branch. A process that systematically tracks reasons and corrects errors possesses a form of guidance control relevant to responsibility, whereas a bypassed, compulsive, or reasons-insensitive process does not. This creates a principled distinction beyond mere social convenience.

novelty.explanation: This introduces a structured testing framework for guidance control absent from the participant's live functional examples.

newArguments.title: A metaphysical budget
newArguments.text: Pragmatism can impose a metaphysical budget: every additional ontological commitment should purchase a specified explanatory gain that cannot be obtained through less demanding models. Experience, value, and inquiry remain admissible subjects because they organize observation, action, and correction; an independently real absolute requires a further demonstration that it improves prediction, unification, normative understanding, or error diagnosis. This budget does not prejudge unfamiliar metaphysics as false. It makes admission symmetrical and revisable, preventing both automatic scientistic exclusion and unrestricted acceptance while giving Bradleyan idealism a clear route to earn its stronger commitments.

novelty.explanation: The metaphysical-budget criterion is a genuinely new operational framework for the con side's admission-standard concern.
